Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Arun Monga
Order 07/10/2024

1. Petitioners are before this Court seeking quashing of an Fir No.20/2024, dated 09.04.2024,
registered under Sections 498A, 406, 504 & 506 of Ipc and Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act,
1961, at Mahila Police Station (Chittorgarh), District Chittorgarh.
2.

At the very outset, the learned Public Prosecutor states that the investigating agency, after conducting an investigation, has prepared a negative Final Report (FR) and has filed it before the competent Court.
The factual report produced by the learned Public Prosecutor is taken on record.
3. In view of the aforesaid statement made by learned Public Prosecutor, the instant petition is disposed of as infructuous.
Pending application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of.

(ARUN MONGA),J 265-/Jitender//-
